column2: cancelled, "authorised".

Reference translation. Date differences take the dative: "in 2 Jahren", "vor 2 Jahren".

Gerunds for ongoing states ("subiendo"); failures as nouns ("error de importación").

Ongoing states as "wordt …"; job, pipeline, build kept as loanwords.

kuluttua + genitive for future differences.

do zapłaty for payment due.

Date differences: "před 2 lety" (instrumental).
Ticket = "požiadavka". "zhoda pri všetkých:" kept as a label (locative not available).
Dual via {two}; "vsako 101 sekundo" for the one category above 1.
plačilo prejeto for payment captured is a judgment call.
Noun after "из N" in the genitive; plain counts genitive for 2+.
через 1 неделю via CLDR accusative.
Noun after "з N" in the genitive; "через"/"тому" + accusative.
Noun forms: few = nominative plural, 10+ genitive plural.
po 2 metų (genitive), "prieš 2 metus" (accusative).
Singular noun after numbers; "közül" avoids suffixes on arguments.
20+ take "de" ("20 de fișiere"); reflexive verbs avoid gender agreement.
așteaptă răspuns for waiting on.
Singular noun after numbers; % before the number ("%50").
talep yükseltildi for ticket escalated.
English tech loanwords with Indonesian affixes ("di-deploy").
Native terms ("saluran paip", "atur letak").
Plural agreement through plural selects; "retkroĉilo" for webhook.
pipeline and "token" kept in English.
Noun before the number ("siku 5"); "kabla ya sasa" for past differences.
SVE-las for CPU load; "kas" for cache.
Counter 件 with the noun; 週の終わり for end of week (週末 means weekend).
Label shapes avoid particles that depend on the inserted word.
Counter 个; 本周结束 for end of week.
Taiwan vocabulary (檔案, 資料庫, 權杖, 快取). Ticket = 票證 (工單 is the alternative).
Six plural forms; 100+ take the singular.
خلال/قبل frames keep the nominative (no CLDR case data).
=1 for singulars, since CLDR puts 0 in "one".
Review: throughput_remaining shows the caller's singular {unit} after any count ("noch 5 Datei"); the template has no plural argument.
Review: throughput_remaining now shows {unit}, singular after any count; others_count's "1 anden" assumes a common-gender referent.
Review: billing.canceled is "uppsagd" (a cancelled subscription); "avslutad" would also do.
Review: "feature flag" kept as the usual anglicism (fr-CA says "indicateur de fonctionnalité"); throughput_remaining never pluralizes {unit}.
Review: ticket.ticket_escalated "ticket inoltrato" loses the higher-level sense of escalation.
Review: "a cada {every} dias" kept; "de {every} em {every} dias" is the more Portuguese idiom.
Review: online/offline unified as "verkossa"/"ei verkossa"; system.uptime "käytettävyys" assumes a percentage.
Review: states use the -mamış form (kaydedilmemiş); form.pristine "değiştirilmedi" kept to pair with form.dirty.
Review: recurrence "каждые 21 минуту" keeps the common plural rather than strict "каждую 21 минуту".
Review: times_noun's fraction form "раза" is the counting genitive ("у півтора раза"), deliberately not "разу".
Review: no number_comparison.case, so the quantity stays nominative; access.viewer "peržiūrėtojas" unverified against Google's wording.
Review: availability.none "žádné dostupné {other}" agrees only with masculine-inanimate and feminine nouns.
Review: payment.payment_captured "platba stiahnutá"; "strhnutá" may be the more formal term.
Review: times_noun =0 "从未{other}" reads well only with verb-like nouns (重试), not plain nouns (文件).
Review: verb and participle agreement is masculine throughout; "कल" is both yesterday and tomorrow, so it reads back as the past and not exact.
Review: "hamisha" serves export, move and migrate; "hoja" serves both query and argument.
Review: others_count adds "mục" (item), wrong if the others are people.
Review: editorial_percent.word always says "procentoj" ("1 procentoj").
Review: recurrence second/minute/hour/quarter/year and business_days/working_hours have no separate many form; the accusative only shows as optional tanween there.
